title: FBI documents tracking Puharich's movements in Israel

tellings.quote: only thing we were able to get was this big chunk of FBI documents which was basically monitoring all of his movements in Israel

plain: A researcher named Greg says on Jesse Michels' podcast that, using a US law that lets anyone request government records, the only thing his team could get was a large batch of FBI files on Andrija Puharich, a scientist said to have links to the CIA and to have contacted an alien council. Greg says the files, from the early 1970s, mostly tracked Puharich's movements in Israel, which would mean the FBI was keeping close watch on him.
